purpose: Public-source evidence/measurement readiness, not a genotype table or an evolutionary reconstruction

source_records.sample_scope: Published 37 studied accessions, of which 25 newly sequenced young-leaf SRA libraries and 12 comparative previously published samples; not 37 new SRA records
source_records.limitations: Leaf RNA does not measure floral competence; lineage divergence is not pigment-loss date; recent gene-flow limitation is not proof against historical introgression; experimental floral expression wording requires separately verifiable methods.

source_records.system: Cirsium japonicum var. takaoense white/bluish-purple morphs
source_records.sample_scope: Six aza3-curated morph-labelled young-leaf libraries: 3 white + 3 bluish-purple, one plant per locality, confounded morph/geography
source_records.limitations: Three-vs-three morph labels are confounded with site/elevation; no comparable floral-stage expression, pigment chemistry, or proof of a restored pathway; DFR/ANS homologous leaf reads are at most retention candidates.

source_records.sample_scope: Published genus-level molecular/functional evidence; two outcomes within one genus, not independent plant clades
source_records.limitations: AN2 reading-frame restoration and DPL regulatory deployment are molecularly supported, but no calibrated history-dependent plant-colonization rate or genomewide locality ancestry inference is established here.

source_records.system: Angiosperm visible flower-colour evolutionary memory clades
source_records.sample_scope: Comparative visible-phenotype phylogenetic summary across clades, not organ-specific ability assays
source_records.limitations: Relative phylogenetic similarity of visible floral hues does not imply pigment-pathway competence, molecular reacquisition, or an independently reconstructed dispersal direction.
